project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Mainstream Dark Arrangement

arrangement.notes: Cinematic rise-and-fall dynamic shaping the dark mood of West Coast hip-hop mainstream style.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Energy ramp up and main hook entry

layers.name: time_stretching
layers.description: Bass sample stretched and pitch shifted

layers.name: chop_and_roll
layers.description: Rapid chopping and rolled playback of chords

layers.name: slice_and_dice
layers.description: Melody sliced into small segments for rhythmic variation

layers.name: micro_sample_slices
layers.description: Vocal lines chopped into micro samples for effect

layers.name: glitch_cutups
layers.description: Sampled glitch cuts used as effect elements

sound_intent.style: West Coast Hip-Hop mainstream with dark tonalities and cinematic dynamic shifts
sound_intent.texture_focus: Sample chopping and layering with organic rhythmic feel

track_roles.drums: main rhythmic driver using chopped sample techniques
track_roles.bass: foundation with sampled and processed bassline chops
track_roles.chords: harmonic support via rhythmic chord chops
track_roles.vocal: lyrical and atmospheric vocal sample chops
track_roles.fx: transitional and textural effects with chopped glitch samples

designer_intent.goal: Create a dark, cinematic West Coast Hip-Hop arrangement using mainstream variation emphasizing sample chopping techniques in channel naming.

presetor_intent.apply_preset: Preset focusing on warm analog textures and crisp dynamics suitable for West Coast Hip-Hop dark moods.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum arrangements using sample chop techniques with dynamic energy profiles fitting cinematic rise and fall.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass layers using pitch-shifted, time-stretched, and reversed chops for dark atmospheric groove.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chord layers with sliced, rolled, and rhythmically chopped samples to support moody atmosphere.

melody_generator.brief: Produce textural melodic fragments with sample slicing and dicing techniques without explicit melodies.

ai_designer.brief: Compose arrangement structure adhering to requested sections and energy curve maintaining dark mainstream West Coast vibe.

presetor.brief: Apply sound presets targeting cinematic dynamic shaping and warm/smooth tonal balance for the genre.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions and energy flow following the cinematic rise and fall profile accurately.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix with clean channel audio ensuring clarity of chopped sample layers and dynamic energy transitions.
